title: drupilot PHP rules (config/php/rules.json)
description: The PHP-version rules drupilot reasons about: compat Rector rules (fix a deprecation without needing a PHP above the floor), deny rules (never applied, also inside level sets), report-only constructs and removed constructs no rule fixes. Seeded by hand, later audited against the pinned Rector. Every rule carries deprecated_in and/or removed_in, except a deny rule, which may carry neither (a rule denied for what it emits, as AR-03 shows). Only a verified rule may be applied or block a port.

rector_version.description: The rector/rector version whose source the rule class names were checked against.

rule.description: The Rector rule class, or null for a construct no rule fixes.

output_min_php.description: The lowest PHP the fixed code runs on.

drupal_safe.description: Whether the rewrite keeps Drupal behaviour (false for __sleep/__wakeup, see DependencySerializationTrait).

detect.description: For a construct no rule fixes: a POSIX ERE (prefixed ere:) that finds it.

exclude.description: A POSIX ERE (prefixed ere:) for the lines a detect match must not count, such as a method of the same name being declared (ERE has no lookbehind).

src.description: Where deprecated_in/removed_in come from (php.net migration guides).

rule_src.description: Where the rule class was found (the rector-src tree at the tag).
